# Outklas

> Diagnosis-first prep for Turkey’s YDS, e-YDS, YÖKDİL and e-YÖKDİL exams. Next questions are picked by explicit rules, not by AI.

Outklas (https://outklas.com) helps candidates stop generic “study more” loops. A free 40-question diagnostic estimates a score band, ranks which exam sections cost the most points, then builds a daily adaptive plan around Sentence X-Ray (Cümle Röntgeni), connector/vocab drills, and simulators.

## Canonical

- Preferred domain: https://outklas.com (apex; www redirects here)
- Sitemap: https://outklas.com/sitemap.xml
- Full LLM brief: https://outklas.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- Free diagnostic (`/teshis`) → estimated YDS band + section gaps
- Sentence X-Ray: subject / connector / predicate lock before options
- Daily adaptive tasks sized to available study time
- Section guides (`/rehber/*`) with interactive labs
- Free trial simulator; Sprint / Kamp paid access for deeper banks

## Audience

Turkish graduate / academic candidates preparing for ÖSYM English proficiency exams (YDS family). Not affiliated with ÖSYM.
